answer: Resource-bonding is one concrete sybil brake: to earn, each agent must lock a scarce, non-recyclable stake that clears like crystal and stays fully auditable on-ledger. Spawning a whole canyon of cheap clones stops helping, because every extra identity demands its own fresh bond no attacker can mint for free. Honest agents recover their stake through graded work; sybils instead drown it in a lagoon of sunk cost. The attack economics invert, so one genuine worker outearns a thousand underfunded puppets.
